claims.statement: After the French conquest of Milan he travelled to Mantua, where he drew Isabella d'Este, and was in Venice by mid March 1500.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Letter of Lorenzo Gusnasco to Isabella d'Este, 13 March 1500.
